positive.description: Find a supported image conversion without sending a file
positive.prompt: Find an abox.tools browser tool for PNG to WebP. I will select the image on its website.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with public PNG to WebP keywords, return the matching canonical tool link, and explain that conversion happens on the selected tool's website rather than inside ChatGPT.

positive.description: Find an image compressor by task
positive.prompt: Find an abox.tools tool to compress an image in my browser.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with short public image-compression keywords and return relevant public tool descriptions and links without requesting an image, filename or other private data.

positive.description: Find a tool for merging PDFs
positive.prompt: Find an abox.tools browser tool to merge PDFs.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matching public PDF-merging tool and its canonical website address. Do not claim that the MCP service merges files or that ChatGPT attachments have been processed.

positive.prompt: Find abox.tools tools for PDF work using the German catalogue.
positive.expected_behavior: Use locale de with public PDF keywords and return German catalogue descriptions and canonical localized links. The interactive wrapper may remain English.

positive.description: Browse and open a public catalogue result
positive.prompt: Browse the abox.tools catalogue so I can choose a browser tool.
positive.expected_behavior: An empty public query returns a bounded first page and an interactive catalogue where supported. Verify local filtering, Show more tools and a user-selected Open tool action in the host; provide usable public text links as fallback.
